page0.text:
We make our way through the town after dark.
It's a little past eight.
The station is at its most crowded hour, and Saber and I stare at the map of the town.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page0:1

page1.text:
"We have checked most of the main buildings around this area. Is there anywhere else we can go?"
"Let's see. There's a factory a little further out from here. We should probably go check it out since people gather there. Not that factories are exactly Shinji's style."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page1:1

page2.text:
...We do make conversation now, but it's still hard for me to look Saber in the eye.
I think our conversation from earlier is still stuck in my head.
Saber's acting like it didn't happen, which bothers me even more.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page2:1

page3.text:
"What about you, Saber? Can you sense Rider's presence?"
"...No, I cannot. I fought her once, so I should be able to sense her."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page3:1

page4.text:
An odd feeling prickles my skin.
Even I can feel the wave of magical energy that washes over us.
There is no way that Saber can't.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page4:1

page5.text:
"Shirou. I do not believe I need to tell you, but..."
"I know. Are they close, Saber?"
"No. They are not close enough, but we are most definitely being watched. This wave of magical energy is likely an attempt to provoke us."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page5:1

page6.text:
If we're being watched...that means they've fallen into our trap.
Releasing so much magical energy is an obvious attempt to lure us out.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page6:1

page7.text:
"So...is this Rider?"
My mind changes gears.
The awkwardness between Saber and me earlier disappears.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page7:1

page8.text:
"I will track the source of magical energy. Please be careful, Master."
I nod.
The wave of bloodlust I feel stinging at my skin is coming from the direction of the office district as it slowly empties of people.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page8:1

page9.text:
Today, of all days, maybe there'll be nobody working overtime.
Most of the lights in the windows of the building seen as the heart of Shinto are dark.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page9:1

page10.text:
There aren't many people on the sidewalks, and we have a pretty clear view of the building.
I don't see anyone suspicious. If Shinji's anywhere, he'll be up ahead... Maybe in the park we just left.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page10:1

page11.text:
I feel the bloodlust growing more intense.
The enemy's nearby.
Or more like...
"..."
A chill runs up my spine.
If even I can feel this aura of bloodlust, then we're probably already in enemy territory.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page11:1

page12.text:
"Saber, be careful. Something's not right."
"You are correct. I do not believe they would attack us with so many others present, but it is difficult to be certain with this foe. It is best to be cautious."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page12:1

page13.text:
We both nod in silent agreement and make our way toward the park.
It's probably best to ignore the oppressive sense of a knife being pressed to my throat.
Shinji and Rider are nowhere around the office district.
If they're going to attack, it's probably going to be somewhere in the park, where there won't be anyone else around...
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page13:1

page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page14:1

page15.text:
I turn towards Saber.
She rushes towards me like a bolt of lightning.
And blocks a blow aimed straight at my head.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page15:1

page16.text:
"Gh—!?"
I look up.
A massive building towers overhead.
Clinging to the side of that building like some kind of spider...is Rider.
"Wha...?"
Her hair is long enough to cover her entire body, her limbs supple and white.
The masked woman is indeed our enemy...Rider!!!
"...Fh."
She licks her lips as she stares down at me.
The hairs on the back of my neck stand on end.
There's no mistaking it.
She came spiraling down from the top of the building, aiming to take my head in a sneak attack from our blind spot.
Saber lands on the ground.
In the time it took for her to rush in to block Rider's attack, Saber summoned her armor.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page16:1

page17.text:
"Saber, she's...!"
"I will go after her! Please stay here, Shirou!"
"Eh!? Go after her? How!?"
Saber kicks off from the ground.
She disappears into the sky with a glint of silvery armor.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page17:1

page18.text:
"Wha...!?"
Rider clinging to the side of the building like that is absurd enough, but Saber leaping skyward in pursuit of her is just outright ridiculous.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page18:1

page19.text:
No. They're Servants. Normal logic doesn't apply here.
Like Rider, Saber moves along the side of the building, striking at her with dizzying speed!
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page19:1

page20.text:
The two shadows clash and cross against each other.
The sight of the two of them fighting overhead, darting along the building as they climb into the air, is like watching two fighter jets.
All the while, I...
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十日目-02:page20:1
